name: Ijiraq
description: The ijiraq is a shapeshifting being of Inuit religion and oral tradition, said to live between the worlds of the living and the dead, glimpsed only at the edge of vision and known to take and hide away children.
origin: The ijiraq is part of Inuit religion and folklore, especially among the Inuit of the eastern Canadian Arctic, the central Arctic islands, and the high Arctic. The term is well-attested in North Baffin Inuktitut.
